counterfactual_missing_items: absence of BCL-2 positivity or clonal rearrangement to support malignancy
absence of typical discoid lesions (follicular plugging, atrophy) for DLE
absence of epidermal changes characteristic of photodermatitis on biopsy
decisive_items: a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center
erythema appeared in the area irradiated with UV-A 48 hours afterwards
response.rationale: C1 and R2 share the same core biopsy evidence, but C1 adds the B-cell subtype specification (CD20+, BCL-2-), which is more complete and directly aligns with the germinal center morphology. R2 is the parent without subtype. R1, R3, and R4 are weaker: R1 lacks DLE-specific features and has normal ANA; R3 has phototest positivity but biopsy contradicts; R4 suggests lymphoma but BCL-2 negativity and lack of atypia favor benign hyperplasia.

rejected.why: No discoid lesions, normal ANA/complement, and biopsy shows germinal centers not typical of DLE.
Phototest positivity is present but biopsy shows lymphoid hyperplasia, not photodermatitis; no epidermal changes.
Lymphoma is unsupported by BCL-2 negativity and lack of cytologic atypia; benign hyperplasia is more consistent.
